title: MSFS 2024 Sim Update 7.1 Released — Important Flight-Model Correction
summary: Microsoft has officially released Sim Update 7.1, version 1.9.21.0.
body:
Date: 23 October 2026

Developer: Microsoft / Asobo Studio

Simulator: MSFS 2024

Status: Confirmed release

Microsoft has officially released Sim Update 7.1, version 1.9.21.0.

The important change for BizJet Pilot readers is a correction to an aerodynamic calculation that had incorrectly reduced aircraft drag.

Previous reporting identified affected aircraft including the FSReborn Phenom 300E and SimWorks Studios PC-12. However, the official release notes do not specify individual aircraft or quantify the performance improvement.

This is particularly relevant to pilots concerned with accurate cruise performance, descent planning and aircraft handling.

Official source: Microsoft Flight Simulator — SU7.1 Release Notes

Corroboration: MSFS Addons — Drag Calculation Issue
